scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/ui run build && npm --prefix packages/api run build && npm --prefix packages/devkit run build && node packages/devkit/dist/cli.js build-all extensions
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/api test && npm --prefix packages/ui test && npm --prefix packages/devkit test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/api run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/ui run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/devkit run typecheck
scripts.dev: npm run build && node packages/devkit/dist/cli.js dev
